text.title: 一个人的价值
text.body: 一个人的价值不是由自己决定的，而是由身边的一切决定的。|你周围的人和环境，决定了你的价值。
text.en: A person's value is not decided by themselves, but by everything around them. The people around you and the environment you live in decide your value.
